annotations.title: BIC/SWIFT code check: structure, country and branch

description: Check a BIC (SWIFT code) against the ISO 9362 structure: institution code, a real country code with its name, location code, branch code, whether it is the head office (XXX or 8 characters), a test BIC or a passive participant, and the 11-character form. Computed locally; it checks the format and country, not whether the bank exists. Use before an international transfer or to clean payment data; for account numbers use validate_iban. Example: bic=DEUTDEFF500. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: bic_validate
